name: ZX_TRX_TELEMETRY_DATA
description: This table stores the metrics for transactional tax API calls for a document for which the tax calculation API is called. Currently, a record will be created for every transaction for which the tax calculation call is performed by a Tax Partner.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the application event class for the transaction

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction

columns.name: INTERNAL_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Internal organization identifier of the transaction

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier for the transaction

columns.name: FIRST_PTY_ORG_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for the first party organization of the transaction

columns.name: DEFAULT_TAXATION_COUNTRY
columns.description: Default taxation country code for the transaction

columns.name: TAX_PROVIDER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier of the third party service provider that has determined the tax for the transaction

columns.name: BILLING_CALENDAR_YEAR_MONTH
columns.description: Indicates the specific period during which the tax calculation API was first called for the transaction. Valid format YYYY-MM

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
